mapper.select: SELECT id, receiver_type, receiver_id, category, message_type, biz_type, biz_id, title, content, mandatory_inbox, read_at, created_at FROM notification WHERE id = #{id} AND receiver_type = 'USER' AND receiver_id = #{receiverId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE receiver_type = 'USER' AND receiver_id = #{receiverId}
